hope: Spend 3 Hope to force an adversary within Far range to reroll an attack or damage roll.

features.name: Prestidigitation
features.short: Perform harmless, subtle magical effects at will, such as changing an object’s color, creating a smell, lighting a candle, floating a tiny object, illuminating a room, or repairing a small object.

features.name: Strange Patterns
features.short: Choose a number from 1 to 12. When you roll it on a Duality Die, gain a Hope or clear a Stress. You can change the number when you take a long rest.

wizard.school-of-knowledge.name: Prepared
wizard.school-of-knowledge.short: Take an additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

wizard.school-of-knowledge.name: Adept
wizard.school-of-knowledge.short: When you Utilize an Experience, you can mark a Stress instead of spending a Hope, and double your Experience modifier for that roll.

wizard.school-of-knowledge.name: Accomplished
wizard.school-of-knowledge.short: Take an additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

wizard.school-of-knowledge.name: Perfect Recall
wizard.school-of-knowledge.short: Once per rest, when you recall a domain card from your vault, reduce its Recall Cost by 1.

wizard.school-of-knowledge.name: Brilliant
wizard.school-of-knowledge.short: Take an additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

wizard.school-of-knowledge.name: Honed Expertise
wizard.school-of-knowledge.short: When you use an Experience, roll a d6. On a 5 or higher, use it without spending Hope.

wizard.school-of-war.name: Battlemage
wizard.school-of-war.short: Gain an additional Hit Point slot.

wizard.school-of-war.name: Face Your Fear
wizard.school-of-war.short: When you succeed with Fear on an attack roll, deal an extra 1d10 magic damage.

wizard.school-of-war.name: Conjure Shield
wizard.school-of-war.short: While you have at least 2 Hope, add your Proficiency to your Evasion.

wizard.school-of-war.name: Fueled by Fear
wizard.school-of-war.short: Face Your Fear’s extra magic damage becomes 2d10.

wizard.school-of-war.name: Thrive in Chaos
wizard.school-of-war.short: When you succeed on an attack, mark a Stress after rolling damage to make the target mark an additional Hit Point.

wizard.school-of-war.name: Have No Fear
wizard.school-of-war.short: Face Your Fear’s extra magic damage becomes 3d10.
